newsitem.title: USA: Ikon Office unit offers lease options.
newsitem.headline: Ikon Office unit offers lease options.

text.p: Ikon Office Solutions Inc on Wednesday said its technology services unit started a program that allows customers to choose leasing options.
The options include delayed payments, seasonal and skipped payments, and programs for upgrading a customer's office technology, the company said.
Ikon, which distributes photocopiers and other office equipment, can also tailor a lease to fit a customer's needs, said Steve Logan, financial services director of the unit.
It said that through its financing unit, Ikon Capital Inc, it will make available financing and leasing for all hardware, software and services provided by the technology services unit.
